errors.meaning: Payload or cross-object contract validation failed.
The payload declares an unsupported schema major or minor version.
The requested main task does not exist.
The requested agent instance does not exist.
The supplied expected revision is stale.
An idempotency key was reused with a different command payload.
The requested state transition is not present in the status catalog.
The task plan is valid but the required agent adapter is not available.
An Agent workbench URL failed ownership, origin, or Adapter allowlist validation.
An automatic retry would exceed count, Token, or cost policy.
No enabled complete credential pair can be allocated.
A credential pair or its pinned revision is incomplete or inconsistent.
A path is absolute, traverses upward, or resolves outside the task root.
An imported or published asset failed type, size, source, or path validation.
A published asset no longer matches its final-file manifest digest.
The instance process could not be started or did not become healthy.
No real Master Gateway is configured or the configured gateway is unreachable.
The configured Master Gateway rejected or failed a planning run.
